description: Explicit maintained source changes made during monorepo integration; original identities and original hashes are never replaced. Current full file hashes are also covered by compliance/rust-sources.json.

changes.change: Gate OsStr/OsString imports with the same std and (unix or windows) condition already used by their implementations, so wasm32 builds do not fail on unused imports. Public API and existing platform implementation gates are retained.
changes.validation: Confirmed by Rust/Wasm compilation in this integration; final build result is recorded separately.
